comment: A loft from a circle to a square through a rail tied to Intersect points (mitcad#1944; tools/ui-loft-rail-intersect-test.sh and its Windows and macOS twins). Sketch1 F1 on XY: a 20 mm circle round the origin. Plane1 F2 40 mm up; Sketch2 F3 on it: a 20 mm square round the axis, its right side c2 at x = 10. Sketch3 F4 on XZ (x along X, y along -Z): Intersect of the circle (p1 at x = 10, p2 at x = -10, in the circle's order from its start at x = 10) and of the square's right side (p3 at x = 10, 40 up); the rail c4 from p1 to p3, meeting the square in its side's middle; the loose rail c5 from p2 to a new point p6 0.3 mm outside the square's left side (a sketch's points and curves share one numbering).
Sketch3's Intersect points use Sketch1 and Sketch2, which hides them by default: shown again, for the loft to pick their profiles.
